summary: Public projects created on 27 December 2025: 3 repos.
intro: Three tools for agent and desktop workflows: a recovery boot target for using an agentic CLI on Ubuntu, a slash command that pushes agents to reuse existing solutions, and a KDE Plasma action for quick background removal.

projects.name: Claude System Recovery Mode
projects.description: Boot target for using an agentic CLI for system recovery on Ubuntu (adapting to other GRUB-supporting OSes should be simple; for non-Linux envs, fork and modify).

projects.name: No Wheel Inventions
projects.description: Slash command for Claude (and agents) to encourage them to avoid reinventing the wheel

projects.name: Quick RMBG
projects.description: Dolphin action for KDE Plasma to quickly invoke RMBG for background removal with support for two-pass and infinite-pass operation modes
